liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lucy In The Sky WIth Diamonds** (2 reviews): Reviewer found the Lucy great fun; The crowd went wild when the band started into Lucy [10][12]
- **Dark Star** (1 review, 1 other source): Jerry slid into the Dark Star intro mid-Playin' jam; it went nowhere, and he left the stage first; Only the first verse of Dark Star is sung [7][14]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Opener was hot and well jammed; Vince Welnick had been solo keyboardist about a year [13]
- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Jerry sang it with notably clear enunciation [17]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Weir altered lyrics, naming Bill and Mickey in place of Cain and Abel and of TS Eliot [17]
- **Handsome Cabin Boy Jam** (1 other source): The previous Handsome Cabin Boy jam was on 09-12-90 [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-17.dsbd.miller.79050.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 4.19/5 by 16 [1]
- **gd1993-03-17.akg460.swayne-jones-joe.sbeok.85163.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: New source is complete; only flaw is a split-second signal saturation when the drummers pounded hard [2]
- **gd1993-03-17.117743.naks.boedicker.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 153 min [5]. Said about its sound: Uploader calls the sound nice and crisp, with a tape flip after Desolation Row losing no music [5]
- **gd93-03-17.sbd.ladner.4979.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 142 min; rated 4.07/5 by 30 [6]. Said about its sound: This copy lacks a separate track for the Handsome Cabin Boy jam, and Eternity is cut [12]
- **gd1993-03-17.138877.AMS.ST-250.S2.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 14 songs; 117 min [7]. Said about its sound: Mic pattern likely Blumlein; applause and screams truncated, with minor digital static in a few spots [7]

## Around the show

- Strict security kept the reviewer outside until midway through Wang Dang Doodle, so the Shakedown Street opener was missed [10]
- Show followed the huge storm that had paralyzed the East Coast; fans struggled to get there [11]
- Rumor held that Slick Willy and/or Al Bore Jr. were present [11]
- Bitterly cold in the DC area, with late-season snow and ice covering March; reviewer stood side stage [13]
- Reviewer had been stuck in Ohio the week before, missing the only Dead show ever cancelled for weather [15]
- Heavy snow had hit DC, causing chaos; this was the reviewer's roughly fifth Dead show [16]
- Reviewer watched Lucy from behind Mickey and Bill, and thought the first-set new songs weak [18]
- Reviewer ranks it among the finest shows of 1993, especially the second set before drums [10]
- Reviewer thinks it was the best of that year's three Cap Center shows [12]
- On an audience tape, the crowd sounds energized but the playing doesn't match that intensity [14]
- Reviewer finds it better in every way than the 16th; band sounds more in sync [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-17.dsbd.miller.79050.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]. Also: Lucy encore was moved to the end of set one to fit two discs; set two and encore are seamless [1]
- **gd1993-03-17.akg460.swayne-jones-joe.sbeok.85163.flac16**: taped by Scott Swayne, Roger Jones, and Joe; source: AKG 460/CK8's -> Panasonic SV-255 -> (clone) TEAC DA-P20 FR-DC OTS [2]. Also: Taped with AKG 460/CK8 mics and a Marantz PMD-700; uploader speculates a relation to shnid 4681 [2]
- **gd1993-03-17.117743.naks.boedicker.flac16**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source: Sony D6 Cassette master(Dolby B On)>Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Playback,Dolby Off)> Edirol R-09 HR(24/44.1 KHZ)>Cd Wav… [5]
- **gd93-03-17.sbd.ladner.4979.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN [6]
- **gd1993-03-17.138877.AMS.ST-250.S2.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Ron Keyser; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 2, Taped by Ron Keyser: AMS ST-250 Soundfield mic > Modified Sony D10Pro> DAT - FOB; John Ammons Transfer from his DAT clone of the master;… [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-03-18 Capital Centre, Landover, MD, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-03-18-capitol-centre-landover-md-usa/) [26]
